description: Use this for the Go-specific realization of the SKELETON→RED→GREEN→REFACTOR TDD cycle — interface skeletons returning `errNotImplemented` stubs, table-driven failing tests with `*testing.T` + `t.Run` + `t.Parallel`, gomock controller setup, assertion-first test shape, `errors.Is`/`require.NoError` conventions, and compile-time interface assertions via `var _ I = (*T)(nil)`. Pairs with the language-neutral `tdd-patterns` skill (cycle + agent coordination); this skill is the Go syntax layer. Triggers: testing.T, t.Run, t.Parallel, t.Cleanup, gomock.NewController, errNotImplemented, table-driven, *_test.go, errors.Is, require.NoError, var _ Interface.
